title: The Voice Message at Midnight
title_ja: 真夜中に届いた音声メッセージ
fact_notes: 登場人物・場所・具体的な出来事や結果は架空の事例。特定の実在の制度、診療上の助言、研究結果の説明ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Mei and Lucia had become close friends while participating in an international summer program.
sentences.ja: メイとルシアは国際的な夏のプログラムに参加している間に親友になった。

sentences.en: After returning to their home countries, they promised to stay in touch through messages.
sentences.ja: 帰国後はメッセージで連絡を取り続けると約束した。

sentences.en: At first, both friends enjoyed exchanging short voice recordings almost every day.
sentences.ja: 最初、二人はほぼ毎日短い音声録音を交換することを楽しんだ。

sentences.en: Their different daily schedules, however, gradually made regular communication more difficult.
sentences.ja: しかし生活時間の違いから定期的な交流は徐々に難しくなった。

sentences.en: One night, Mei woke up when several messages arrived on her phone after midnight.
sentences.ja: ある夜、真夜中を過ぎて携帯電話にメッセージが何件か届き、メイは目を覚ました。

sentences.en: Lucia was excited about a school performance and wanted to share the experience immediately.
sentences.ja: ルシアは学校の発表に興奮し、その体験をすぐに共有したかった。

sentences.en: Mei was happy for her friend but needed enough sleep before an important examination.
sentences.ja: メイは友人のことをうれしく思ったが、重要な試験の前には十分な睡眠が必要だった。

sentences.en: She hesitated to say anything because she did not want Lucia to think the messages were unwelcome.
sentences.ja: メッセージを歓迎していないと思われたくなかったため、何か言うのをためらった。

sentences.en: Over the following week, Mei sometimes answered much later than she normally would.
sentences.ja: 翌週にかけてメイは普段よりずっと遅く返信することがあった。

sentences.en: Lucia began to wonder whether the friendship had become less important to Mei.
sentences.ja: ルシアは友情がメイにとって以前ほど重要でなくなったのかと思い始めた。

sentences.en: Instead of allowing the misunderstanding to grow, Mei decided to explain her circumstances honestly.
sentences.ja: 誤解を大きくする代わりにメイは自分の事情を正直に説明することにした。

sentences.en: She told Lucia that the recordings were valuable to her, even when she could not listen immediately.
sentences.ja: すぐ聴けなくても録音は自分にとって大切だとルシアに伝えた。

sentences.en: Lucia explained that she had imagined Mei was receiving the messages at a convenient time.
sentences.ja: ルシアはメイが都合の良い時間にメッセージを受け取っていると思っていたと説明した。

sentences.en: The two friends decided to stop expecting an immediate response to ordinary messages.
sentences.ja: 二人は通常のメッセージにすぐ返信することを期待しないと決めた。

sentences.en: They also arranged a regular weekend call at a time that suited both of them.
sentences.ja: 二人に都合の良い時間に定期的な週末の通話も設定した。

sentences.en: When something was urgent, they agreed to communicate that clearly rather than guess each other's intentions.
sentences.ja: 緊急の場合は相手の意図を推測せず、それを明確に伝えると合意した。

sentences.en: The new arrangement made their conversations more relaxed and allowed both to focus on their responsibilities.
sentences.ja: 新しい取り決めによって会話はより気楽になり、双方が自分の責任に集中できた。

sentences.en: Neither friend had to prove her affection by being available every hour of the day.
sentences.ja: どちらも一日中連絡可能でいることで愛情を証明する必要はなかった。

sentences.en: They discovered that respecting each other's limits could strengthen a friendship rather than weaken it.
sentences.ja: 互いの限界を尊重することが友情を弱めるのでなく強め得ると分かった。

sentences.en: For Mei and Lucia, staying connected meant finding a rhythm that worked for both people.
sentences.ja: メイとルシアにとってつながり続けるとは、双方に合うリズムを見つけることだった。

questions.prompt: Where did the two friends meet?
questions.explanation_ja: 国際的な夏のプログラム。

options: A decision to stop using phones.

questions.prompt: Why did Lucia send several messages?
options: She wanted Mei to miss an examination.
She planned to end the friendship.
She was excited about a school performance.
questions.explanation_ja: 学校の発表について共有したかった。

questions.prompt: Why did Mei hesitate to explain her concern?
options: She could not understand any recordings.
She feared Lucia might think the messages were unwanted.
She planned to delete her phone permanently.
questions.explanation_ja: 歓迎していないと誤解されたくなかった。

questions.prompt: What did Lucia begin to wonder?
options: Whether Mei was moving to her country.
Whether the school performance was canceled.
Whether the friendship mattered less to Mei.
Whether her phone's recordings were deleted.
questions.explanation_ja: 友情の重要性が下がったかと心配。

questions.prompt: How did Mei address the misunderstanding?
options: She asked Lucia to take an examination.
She sent a message to every student.
questions.explanation_ja: 事情を正直に説明した。

questions.prompt: What did the friends agree about ordinary messages?
options: Only one friend could send a message.
questions.explanation_ja: 普通のメッセージに即答を求めない。

questions.prompt: Why did the new arrangement help their relationship?
options: Both could stay in touch without neglecting their needs.
It required both to be available all day.
It made their daily schedules identical.
questions.explanation_ja: 互いの事情を尊重しながら交流できた。

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the story?
options: Close friends must answer every message immediately.
Healthy communication can include clear expectations and respect for personal limits.
questions.explanation_ja: 期待を明確にし、互いの限界を尊重する。

grammar.focus: while participating in an international summer program
grammar.explanation_ja: while＋現在分詞で同時に行ったことを表す。

grammar.focus: because she did not want Lucia to think
grammar.explanation_ja: because節は理由を、want＋人＋to不定詞はしてほしいことを示す。
stop＋動名詞は行為をやめる。
rather thanは対比する結果を示す。

discourse.role_ja: 連絡の楽しさと時間の違いを対比。
誤解を放置せず説明する転換。
即答を期待しないことに加えて通話を設定。
友情の強化と弱化の対比。

paraphrases.source: Mei and Lucia had become close friends while participating in an international summer program.
paraphrases.rewrite: Mei and Lucia developed a close friendship during an international summer program.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 国際プログラム中に親しくなった。

paraphrases.source: She hesitated to say anything because she did not want Lucia to think the messages were unwelcome.
paraphrases.rewrite: Mei held back because she feared that Lucia might misunderstand her feelings about the messages.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 誤解されることを恐れ言い出せなかった。

paraphrases.source: The two friends decided to stop expecting an immediate response to ordinary messages.
paraphrases.rewrite: They agreed that everyday messages did not require an instant reply.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 普通の連絡に即答は不要とした。

paraphrases.source: They discovered that respecting each other's limits could strengthen a friendship rather than weaken it.
paraphrases.rewrite: They realized that honoring personal boundaries could make their friendship stronger instead of damaging it.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 限界の尊重は友情を強め得る。

cloze.explanation_ja: 誤解を解消しようとした。
緊急時は明確に伝える。
限界を尊重して友情を強める。
